notes: Eleven source and eighteen target tokens each partitioned once.

בְּתוֹךְ is split here: the ASV spends a separate word on each morpheme (in / the midst), so rule 30's one-English-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 governs. Contrast EZK.6.13, where among fuses the same pair.
חָלָל is anarthrous, so the supplied the that makes it a noun phrase joins its own unit under rule 46, headed on the lexeme.
The suffix כֶם is the nomen rectum of תָּוֶךְ and takes of you under rules 18 and 19.
